First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 14-16 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills.
Check
Check the links below the day of for cancellations and weather calls.

About the Fastchix Thursday Morning Ride (Jafe Cycling) group ride

The weekly Thursday-morning group ride of the Fastchix women's group, led by Yvonne Spencer. It covers about 21 to 23 miles at 14-16 mph on a mix of trails and roads, and the route changes with the weather.
